architecture_summary: Modular React app. Static HTML screens → React components. One page per Stitch screen. Shared UI kit (cards, buttons, typography) extracted from `duolingo_card_components_showcase`. Router: React Router v6. State: local only. Styling: CSS modules. No backend integration yet. Ponytail: static data hardcoded, replace with API calls when backend ready.

tickets.title: Extract shared UI kit from card components showcase
tickets.description: Parse `duolingo_card_components_showcase/code.html`. Identify reusable components: buttons, cards, progress bars, avatars, typography styles. Create `src/components/ui/` folder. Implement each as React component with CSS module. Export all in `src/components/ui/index.js`.
acceptance_criteria: All components render pixel-perfect match to Stitch screen
Props cover all variants shown in showcase
CSS modules scoped, no global leakage
Storybook stories optional, skip if time tight

tickets.title: Build landing page (hero + social proof)
tickets.description: Convert `duolingo_landing_focused_hero_social_proof_v1/code.html` to React. Use shared UI kit. Static data hardcoded. Create `src/pages/Landing.jsx`. Split into subcomponents: `HeroSection`, `SocialProofSection`.
acceptance_criteria: CTA buttons link to placeholder routes

tickets.title: Build landing page (feature narrative + community sections)
tickets.description: Convert remaining landing sections. Append to `src/pages/Landing.jsx`. Subcomponents: `FeatureNarrativeSection`, `CommunitySection`. Static data hardcoded.
acceptance_criteria: Scroll animations optional, skip if time tight

tickets.title: Build learning table page

tickets.title: Build pricing page
tickets.description: Convert `duolingo_pricing_page/code.html`. Create `src/pages/Pricing.jsx`. Subcomponents: `PricingTierCard`, `FAQSection`. Static data hardcoded. Use shared UI kit.

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create app shell. Add navigation bar. Wire React Router v6. Routes: `/` (Landing), `/learn` (LearningDashboard), `/table` (LearningTable), `/profile` (Profile), `/pricing` (Pricing). 404 fallback. Use shared UI kit for nav bar. Ponytail: auth placeholder, add real auth when backend ready.
acceptance_criteria: Active route highlighted in nav bar
Responsive: mobile hamburger menu optional, skip if time tight
